aDefectNoCounterCanSee.theStructuralCause: No row in that file carries a packet digest. Checked directly: the row keys are familyId, jurisdiction, currentState, tier, widgetsExposed, exposedByFieldType, exposedByTier, namedControls, builderOptsIn, buildScript, familyDirectory, confirmation, measuredFixtures, strokeOnlyAcrossFixtures, pathPaintingAcrossFixtures, confirmationWhy, sourceAccounting, currentStateWas -- and not one of them is a digest of the packet measured. aSecondDefectNoCounterCanSee.what: ct-cleanslate-petition-set shipped eight ADVISORY findings in its own build-findings.json, one per flattened pushbutton caption, each reading 'Flattening bakes the source form's own pushbutton caption into the page, so a filed copy carries the words at the foot of the sheet. Recorded for visual review.'
aSecondDefectNoCounterCanSee.whyNothingFired: ARTIFACTS on this family was measured by a stroke-only sweep, which cannot see a stream that draws a caption alongside its box. The nine completeness counters do not read build-findings.json advisories. So the builder detected the defect, wrote it down accurately, and every counter that could have escalated it was structurally incapable of doing so. The family held a PASS_COMPLETE_INDEPENDENT verdict while 'Print Form' and 'Reset Form' were printed on the filing.
aSecondDefectNoCounterCanSee.generalisation: An advisory that no obligation reads is a defect the factory has already found and cannot act on. Any family whose build-findings.json carries a flattening_materialised_the_forms_own_widget_caption advisory is worth sweeping on that string alone.
